_readme: Source of truth for lovedbyaireviews.com. Every review the site has ever published lives here. status=live means verified present at source on last_verified; status=archived means it was published once and is no longer at its source (it moves to archive.html). Never hand-edit scores: run scripts/audit_reviews.py or the /review-audit skill.

audit.method: WordPress.org + lovedby.ai via scripts/audit_reviews.py (HTTP). G2, Trustpilot and Google require a real browser (they 403 scripted requests) and are captured via the /review-audit skill.

WordPress.org.note: Score is the WordPress.org API rating (88/100). Includes one 2-star review and one 5-star entry whose text is a complaint, neither of which is quoted on the page.

G2.note: G2 shows per-review scores of 4.5, 4.5 and 5.0. One review is labelled Incentivized (G2 invite).

Trustpilot.note: TrustScore is 4.0 even though all four reviews are 5-star: Trustpilot weights recency and volume. Publish 4.0, not a 5.0 average.

Website.note: First-party testimonials. No verifiable star rating, so this card shows a count only and is excluded from all structured data ratings.

Google.note: Deliberately excluded from the top scorecard row and rendered last on the page. 4 ratings, 3 of which carry text.

reviews.title: Found issues I wouldn’t have caught myself
reviews.author: baha2705
reviews.body: I’ve been using LovedByAI to improve how my WordPress site is understood by AI tools like ChatGPT. The initial scan pointed out several technical and content issues I hadn’t noticed, and it was easy to implement the recommendations. After a few weeks I started seeing better visibility in AI search, and I like that the plugin shows what AI bots are actually finding. I’d still like to see even more integrations and reporting over time, but it’s been a useful addition to my site.

reviews.title: Helped us improve our AI visibility
reviews.author: galroz
reviews.body:
We’ve been using LovedByAI on our website for a several months. The initial scan found several issues with how our pages were structured for AI search, and we used the recommendations to improve the site.

I originally signed up mainly for the optimization, but the monitoring has become one of the most useful features. It helps us see which pages are being mentioned by AI tools and better understand what is working.

We’ve seen an increase in AI mentions since installing it. There are, of course, other factors that affect visibility, but having optimization and monitoring in one place has been very useful.

reviews.title: It just works.
reviews.author: aguelmann
reviews.body:
Adapting to AI search (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude) has been a massive headache lately. I knew we needed to optimize for it, but I really didn’t want to overhaul our site’s codebase or blindly tweak things just for LLM crawlers. Plus, standard SEO tools give you zero insight into AI bot traffic.

I ended up trying LovedByAI, and it actually solves this. It adds a clean, machine-readable layer over your existing site. Human visitors see the exact same layout, but LLMs can easily parse and structure the content.

A few things that stood out to me:

- Zero maintenance. I installed it, left it alone, and haven’t had to rewrite a single page.

- Real analytics. Instead of pasting our URLs into Claude and hoping for the best, the dashboard shows actual bot activity from GPTBot and ClaudeBot, which pages they cite, and the resulting referral traffic.

- No stack conflicts. It dropped right into our current setup without breaking anything.

We started seeing an uptick in crawler hits within a couple of weeks, followed by actual leads coming in through AI chats. If you’re trying to figure out GEO without burning hours on technical debt, I highly recommend checking it out.

reviews.title: My favorite plugin
reviews.author: Crista Cloutier
reviews.body:
I've been working with LovedByAI to help my business become more discoverable through AI and search, and the results have been outstanding. They combine deep technical knowledge with a rare ability to explain things in plain language. Instead of drowning me in jargon, they guided me step by step through what really matters for AI visibility, structured data, and SEO.
 

 What I appreciate most is how thoughtful and proactive they are. They don't just "optimize" and disappear — they look at my entire online presence, anticipate what I'll need next, and come back with clear, prioritized recommendations I can actually implement.
 

 If you're serious about being found in an AI-driven world — and you want a partner who is both strategic and genuinely kind to work with — I HIGHLY recommend LovedByAI!

reviews.title: An SEO/GEO tool built for the new era of search
reviews.author: Andre Guelmann
reviews.body:
AI search isn't going away, and most websites aren't built for it. LovedByAI fills that gap without touching anything you've already built, by adding a machine-readable layer that LLMs like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity can actually see, while your site looks and works exactly the same for humans.
 

 What makes it genuinely useful is the analytics dashboard. AI traffic has always been a black box: you rarely know if bots are crawling you, citing you, or ignoring you entirely. This changes that. You can see which AI systems are visiting, how often, and whether that's translating into citations. That kind of visibility is rare.
 

 If you're serious about staying visible as search shifts toward AI-generated answers, this is worth adding now rather than scrambling to catch up later.

LovedByAI makes AI visibility feel measurable instead of theoretical because it uses my actual data. We fully optimized 49 pages, and the dashboard started giving us clear signals.
